review: V8 E03 final independent engineering verification

findings.scope: New unavailable-channel replacement verification requires independent_reestablishment
Retained pre-repair contradictory review fails at escalation, decision and future supplier authority

assertions.name: routes only proposals through controller credentials and all reviews/history through the current human
enforces auth/session/origin and strict operation shapes without accepting browser authority
starts registration, verification and final decisions without preselected evidence, dates or confirmation
binds proposals to the current supplier/contact and requires explicit supersession for restoration
excludes invoice/credit originals and same-hash relabeling from evidence pickers
keeps rejection holds, approval recertification and no-transfer implications explicit
uses authenticated endpoints and validates operation bodies before any request
uses exact synthetic evidence bytes and separates verification, escalation and final approval stages
E03 governed trusted contact replacement replaces contact only, requires a fresh supplier callback/approval, and preserves immutable source and supplier history
E03 governed trusted contact replacement cannot replace a contact through the legacy supplier proposal
E03 governed trusted contact replacement requires source provenance and source-bound phone before a replacement
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects an invoice phone source even when the original bytes are renamed as a contract
E03 governed trusted contact replacement requires an explicit escalation policy and an independent escalation review when old channel is unavailable
E03 governed trusted contact replacement requires independent reestablishment when replacement declares the old channel unavailable
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects contradictory historical unavailable-channel verification, approved=false
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects contradictory historical unavailable-channel verification, approved=true
E03 governed trusted contact replacement requires old-channel confirmation for available contacts and explicit restoration
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects review and final approval by the source recorder, including a subject alias of the same seat
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained second before activation
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained verifier before activation
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained escalation before activation
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained second after replacement and supplier recertification
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained verifier after replacement and supplier recertification
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained escalation after replacement and supplier recertification
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks retained governor after replacement and supplier recertification
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects stale policy-bound reviews and preserves a superseding repair path
E03 governed trusted contact replacement keeps rejection held until an explicitly reviewed restoration, retaining both proposal histories
E03 governed trusted contact replacement returns exact replays, rejects changed payloads, and serializes competing proposals
E03 governed trusted contact replacement holds new dispatch without agent cancellation; a human decision cancels the unsent operation
E03 governed trusted contact replacement preserves possibly sent command, destination, key and reservations across human replacement
E03 governed trusted contact replacement revalidates replacement roles after a policy group change without rewriting the prior decision
E03 governed trusted contact replacement blocks a supplier proposal verified before the contact change from activating after replacement
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rechecks distinct verifier and final approver seats even if subject aliases differ
E03 governed trusted contact replacement rejects stale hashes and future claimed reviews
E03 governed trusted contact replacement preserves possible-send recovery after replacement with the original operation
E03 governed trusted contact replacement requires case recertification against the new supplier revision without creating a second bill or recognition

does not promote a pre-repair contradictory unavailable-channel verification into current authority
does not approve a complete but contradictory pre-repair contact review
does not reuse approved pre-repair contradictory review at future supplier authority gates
carries each request-bound synthetic identity through real HTTP/service/Convex-test contact mutations; no browser authority overrides
presents the only allowed verification method for each immutable old-channel/resolution combination
withholds review controls for stale contact/revision/policy state and cannot silently supersede a current proposal

V8 independent E03 authority and recovery rechecks retained current human verifier at final approval without changing any financial state
V8 independent E03 authority and recovery rechecks retained current human escalation at final approval without changing any financial state
